correctness.rationale: Under positive independent Poisson clocks, the exact generator has the two independent coordinate reset losses and yields a solvable triangular system for the environment second/fourth moments, tracer second/fourth and mixed moments. Conditional semigroup closure on centered squared position and environmental power yields both covariance formulas for all t≥0. Strict ratio monotonicity and trichotomy follow from positive H derivative and explicit limits, and the dimension identity from variance decomposition. The two-sided Poisson representation proves existence, coupling after resets uniqueness, and all needed fourth moments are finite. Embedded verify.py independently recomputes generator identities symbolically, including the rate-matching case; no finite experiment is substituted for an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A shared fluctuating medium creates dependencies among independently reset tracers; the dimensionless same- versus cross-tracer squared-lag ratio is an intrinsic diagnostic of environmental persistence. The sharp two-clock threshold and exact algebraic critical decay give a qualitative long-time classification, while the nonzero high-dimensional relative squared-radius variance identifies persistent collective disorder; these are motivated structural facts, not arbitrary special values.
